name: webflow-app-preflight
description: Webflow App bundle preflight and server-owned production runtime validation

scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-runtime-runner build && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-preflight-extension build && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-preflight-worker build && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-runtime-template build
scripts.check: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @create-something/bundle-scanner-core typecheck && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-preflight check && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-runtime-runner check && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-preflight-extension check && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-preflight-worker check && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-runtime-template check
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @create-something/bundle-scanner-core test && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-preflight test && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-runtime-runner test && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-preflight-extension test && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-preflight-worker test && pnpm --filter @create-something/webflow-app-review-runtime-template test
